as_told.title: Billy Meier as a Middle East intelligence operative

plain: Billy Meier, a Swiss man known for claiming contact with beings from space, is said to have first worked as a field intelligence agent in the Middle East, getting the name Billy while working in Tehran. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells this twice, drawing on a book called Closer Encounters, and says "The guy was 007. He was a James Bond style super spy." If true, the famous contactee would have had a hidden past in spy work.
